# Newark Law Offices

> Boutique legal representation and strategic advocacy serving corporate and individual clients throughout Texas and Oklahoma.

Newark Law Offices (legal entity: A Newark Firm, LLC) provides litigation, corporate advocacy, bankruptcy, foreclosure defense, and insurance-claim counsel with offices in Dallas, Texas and Edmond, Oklahoma.

- Responsible attorney: Robert C. Newark, III
- Licensed in Texas and Oklahoma state courts
- Admitted to federal courts in Texas, Oklahoma, Colorado, New Mexico, and Arkansas
- Phone: 866-230-7236 | Dallas: 972-332-5733 | Edmond: 405-727-0269
- Case review: https://newarkfirm.com/case-eligibility.html
- Chat widget and lead forms post to the firm’s Cloudflare Worker; they do not create an attorney-client relationship
